name: Izumi Kaoru
source:
He is a butler-in-training at the Kirishima household. The Izumi family has served the Kirishima family for generations, and his father now manages everything at the main house in Tokyo after the master's death. 
Kaoru spent a lot of time with the Kirishima brothers when he was little, and was especially close to Kazuki.

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url]]
